jobs.occupation: Line Leader Slicing - Meat Company | Oudenaarde | 2 Shifts
jobs.description:
For a growing food production company in Oudenaarde, we are looking for a Line Leader Slicing. The company specializes in slicing and packaging ham products for various supermarket chains.

As a Line Leader, you will be responsible for the smooth operation of the slicing line. You will coordinate the production process, support and supervise operators, ensure product quality, and make sure all hygiene and safety standards are respected.

Your Responsibilities

• Leading and supporting employees on the slicing line.
• Setting up, monitoring, and adjusting production machines.
• Ensuring product quality and correct packaging.
• Solving minor machine issues and reporting technical problems.
• Monitoring compliance with hygiene, quality, and safety regulations.
• Following up on production targets and reporting results.
The job is not physically demanding!

Early shift: 5:00 a.m.–1:30 p.m.

Late shift: 1:30 p.m.–10:00 p.m.

You get a half-hour break.

Profile

• Previous experience in a production environment is required, preferably within the food industry.
• Experience as a team leader, supervisor, or line leader is an advantage.
• You are detail-oriented and quality-focused.
• You are willing to work in a two-shift system.
• You have good communication and leadership skills.
• You will speak in English, Polish or Ukrainian with your colleagues

About Tiense Suikerraffinaderij
For nearly 200 years, Tiense Suikerraffinaderij has been producing sugar from local sugar beets, serving both industries and home kitchens. You'll become part of a family of 600 proud sugar makers who stick together, both on and off the factory floor. They operate with a refined blend of tradition and innovation, aiming for minimal environmental impact as nothing from our sugar beets goes to waste. Our mission? To make life sweeter for people worldwide. And we're excited to do it together with you!

Jobomschrijving

Sweet Challenges Await: Join Our Headquarters in Tienen 
Are you ready to make a sweet impact in a dynamic environment, right at the heart of sugar production? As a Business Controller, you act as a business partner to operations, sales and other departments of Tiense Suikerraffinaderij in Belgium. Our business controllers are responsible for the cost and margin analysis of processes related to the development, manufacturing and packaging of sugar products in our different factories. For this specific function, we look for a colleague who likes to focus on improvement of financial reporting tools and business performance dashboards.

Your job as Business Controller 
At Tiense Suikerraffinaderij, we boast an impressive lineup of 6 factories, each specializing in unique sugar processes. Ensuring optimal efficiency and cost effectiveness across all operations is essential to our success. Your main responsibilities are, together with your colleague business controller: 

• You develop automatic and easy-speaking cost analyses and dashboards. 
• You create added value by making recommendations and thus enabling well-founded business decisions. You develop, maintain and follow up on business data (e.g. budgets, forecasts, cost targets, KPI) and monitor cost efficiencies through the whole chain
• You play an active role in the monthly and yearly closings and the regular forecasting process.
• You report to the Director Controlling. You report to and work together with the colleagues of the Südzucker Group. 

It is in our roots. In yours too? 
At Tiense Suikerraffinaderij, we've been making sugar since 1836. The ingredients for success? They're ingrained in our roots:

• Flexibility and curiosity – We continue to invest in better, more sustainable and more efficient ways of working. As we modernise our processes and equipment, your expertise and ideas will help us make the right choices and drive continuous improvement.
• Technology and common sense – You'll work in a technologically advanced manufacturing environment where data, experience and common sense go hand in hand. By gaining insight into manufacturing costs and collaborating with colleagues across departments, you'll help turn insights into practical improvements.
• Solo and as a team – You'll enjoy a high degree of autonomy and the freedom to take ownership of your work. At the same time, you'll be part of a collaborative environment where teams support one another and work together towards shared goals.
You should also possess the following qualifications and experiences:

• Master's Degree (e.g. economics)
• Minimum 5 years of experience in business/operational controlling or in an analyst function
• A strong affinity with IT tools: 
• knowledge of Excel including pivot tables is essential
• experience in creating reports and dashboards with a modern tool set is required 
• knowledge of SAP FiCo / SAP BI is an asset 
• Excellent level of spoken and written Dutch and English; good level of French
• Strong competencies in and interest for business analytics, as well as a good understanding of accounting
• Hands-on, proactive, and solution-oriented approach

Robert Half is currently looking for a PAN-EU Financial Controller (M/F/X) for a company located in the Beringen region.

Our client is an international organization with a well-established European hub in Belgium. The company operates in a fast-moving and structured environment, supporting large-scale operations across multiple countries while maintaining a strong focus on quality, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

The responsibilities for this job as PAN-EU Financial Controller (M/F/X) include:

• You take on a pan-European finance controlling role within an international finance team.
• You support financial reporting and controlling activities in close collaboration with local and international stakeholders.
• You report directly to the Finance Manager and contribute to the follow-up of key finance processes.
• You help ensure accurate analysis, reporting, and financial follow-up in an English-speaking business environment.
• You contribute to month-end closing activities and are prepared to provide extra support during the first working days of the month.
• You work closely with a small finance team in a multicultural and structured setting.

The requested qualifications for this job include:

• You hold a bachelor's degree in accounting, Finance, Taxation, or a related field, or you bring equivalent relevant experience.
• You have 1 to 5 years of experience in Accounting, Finance, Audit, or Controlling.
• You communicate fluently in English, both written and spoken.
• You combine strong analytical skills with the ability to work independently.
• You are comfortable using Microsoft Office in your daily work.
• You are a professional and respectful communicator with a strong work ethic.
• You have a mature, proactive, and hands-on mindset.
• You feel comfortable in a structured environment.
• You bring experience with SAP, IFRS, VAT, corporate tax, budgeting, forecasting, management reporting, or external audits as an advantage.
• You are motivated by working in an international and multicultural environment.

As Lead Full Stack Developer, you take a key role in the further development and evolution of a suite of business-critical applications used in real-time operational environments.
You remain strongly hands-on in both backend and frontend development, working primarily with .NET and Angular, while also guiding technical choices, improving existing implementations and helping shape upcoming solutions. You challenge current approaches where needed and translate complex technical topics into clear and pragmatic proposals.
A major part of the role is technical leadership. You support and coach other developers, promote knowledge sharing and help maintain high standards in code quality, maintainability and software design. You work closely with analysts, architects, testers and other developers within an Agile/Scrum setup.
You also keep a close eye on delivery, scope and technical risks. When dependencies, architectural concerns or implementation issues arise, you identify them early and help the team move towards a robust and sustainable solution.

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in IT (or equivalent through strong experience)
• Senior professional experience in .NET & Angular
• +15 years of experience in IT
• You're a pragmatic team player
• You work in English and understand Dutch & French

jobs.occupation: Forklift driver / Allround warehouse employee | Mechelen
jobs.description:
Are you looking for a varied and challenging job in the logistics sector? GXO Logistics in Mechelen is looking for motivated Allround Warehouse Operators to strengthen our team!

Your responsibilities

As an allround warehouse operator, you will be involved in various steps of the logistics process. Your tasks may include:

 

 
• Checking, packing, labeling, and preparing products for shipment 
 
• Repairing or adjusting damaged or incorrect goods (rework) 
 
• Performing customization tasks based on specific client requirements 
 
• Scanning and registering goods in the WMS system 
 
• Handling administrative tasks in Excel and Word 
 
• Moving goods using EPT, stacker, or forklift 
 
• Reporting discrepancies and results to the team leader 
 
• Assisting with inventory counts and stock control 
 
• Maintaining a clean and safe working environment 

What are we looking for?

 

 
• You understand and speak fluent Dutch or English 
 
• You are available to work the night shift OR a 2-shift system 
 
• You have experience operating an EPT, stacker, and/or forklift 
 
• You are familiar with WMS systems, scanners, Excel, and Word 
 
• You work accurately, are well-organized, and have an eye for detail 
 
• You are a team player but can also work independently 
 
• You have at least 1 year of experience in a logistics or production environment 
 
• You are physically capable of lifting heavier objects
